integrity: The proof separates the all-orders-at-most-three safety argument from the four-dimensional family calculation. The Kershaw 4x4 breakdown witness is explicitly treated as prior work. The new claim is limited to the minimality proof and the exact signed-cycle phase diagram. A standalone exact-rational checker replays the pivot identities and conditioning boundary but does not replace the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The minimal-dimension statement concerns exact-arithmetic, unshifted IC(0) with the natural ordering. The condition-number threshold 5+2sqrt(6) is only for the displayed Jacobi-scaled signed four-cycle family, not a global four-dimensional threshold. Finite-precision breakdown, pivot repair, reordering, threshold dropping, and shifted incomplete Cholesky are outside scope.
title: Sharp signed-cycle onset and minimal dimension for IC(0) breakdown
